name: Moonshrine Ruins
summary: Deep in Blackfathom Deeps, the Moonshrine Ruins lie flooded and seized by the Twilight's Hammer. Their halls once honored Elune, but the cult now carries out dark rituals among the ancient stones.

sections.title: Flooded Halls of Elune
sections.body: Beyond the cavernous Pool of Ask'ar, the Moonshrine Ruins lie along the Ashenvale coast. These partly submerged halls once echoed with chants to Elune, the Moon Goddess. The Great Sundering shattered the temple and drowned its lower levels in seawater. Now murky waters churn with aggressive crabs and serpentine threshadons. The Twilight's Hammer cult holds the stones and performs dark rituals that mock the shrine's sacred origins.

sections.title: The Elemental Depths
sections.body: The flooded ruins connect toward the Forgotten Pool and Moonshrine Sanctum. Beneath their waters rests an ancient runestone bound to the elements. Through it, the Twilight's Hammer manipulates the deeps and calls forth Baron Aquanis, a monstrous water elemental bound to the cult's dark designs.

faq.q: What were the Moonshrine Ruins originally built for?
faq.answer: The Moonshrine Ruins were part of a grand underground temple complex dedicated to Elune, the night elven goddess. The temple was built before the Great Sundering tore the ancient continent apart.

faq.q: Who controls the Moonshrine Ruins now?
faq.answer: The Twilight's Hammer cultists and hostile aquatic beasts, including threshadons and snapping crabs, have overrun the sunken complex.

faq.q: Where do the Moonshrine Ruins lead?
faq.answer: The Moonshrine Ruins lie beyond the tunnels past the Pool of Ask'ar. Their paths lead deeper toward Moonshrine Sanctum and provide access to the Forgotten Pool.
Baron Aquanis is a powerful water elemental summoned through a submerged runestone hidden beneath the ruins. The Twilight's Hammer uses him to serve its dark aims.

angles.text: For a night elf, seeing these sacred halls to Elune flooded and overrun by the cult is a bitter grievance.
For a shaman, the runestone that binds Baron Aquanis shows how the Twilight's Hammer distorts and enslaves elemental forces.
